title: Aajay
desc: Ajay, a kabaddi player, hides Padma from Veerabhadra, a gangster who wants to force her into marrying him. Soon, the two fall in love.

title: Chandralekha
desc: Four suicidal strangers, Chandu, Aishu, Maharaj, and Pravin converge at a guesthouse, only to encounter a supernatural force that upends their plans and their reality.

title: Kanti
desc: A Marathi woman, Reema, and a Kannadiga man, Kanti, fall in love. Their romantic story takes a political turn when Samblekar, a Maharashtrian politician, wants to exploit the situation.

title: Lion Jagapathi Rao
desc: Jagapathi Rao, an eminent lawyer, is known for his fierce ethics. Soon, Jagapathi's life turns upside down when a local politician challenges him to contest the election against him.

title: Namma Basava
desc: A bountiful and helpful boy falls in love with a musician without knowing the fact that a rich spoilt brat is also planning to woo her.
